factual_claims.claim: Results were affected by the scheduled factory shutdown in early January during the transition to a new gas boiler house, which required approximately two months for calibration and start-up.

factual_claims.claim: Cold weather increased energy consumption, and gas prices nearly doubled in late February following the US military attack on Iran; although prices subsequently declined, they remain approximately 50% higher than at the beginning of the year.
